name: Snowflake
label: Snowflake SQL API v2 — statements
description: Snowflake SQL API v2 at https://{account_url}/api/v2/statements. Docs: https://docs.snowflake.com/en/developer-guide/sql-api/reference. Header X-Snowflake-Authorization-Token-Type from config token_type (OAUTH | KEYPAIR_JWT | PROGRAMMATIC_ACCESS_TOKEN). Handler: OfficialApiNode. Never log access_token or SQL that embeds secrets.
author: 5c8b0d45-1d10-4f2e-844c-2318af96b2fa

ports.name: input
ports.description: Per-operation fields. execute.sql requires statement; optional timeout, database, schema, warehouse, bindings. statement.get / statement.cancel require statementHandle. Do not put access_token here. Example: {"operation":"execute.sql","statement":"SELECT 1","warehouse":"COMPUTE_WH"}.

schema.label: operation
schema.description: Overrides config operation when non-blank. EXACT: 'execute.sql' | 'statement.get' | 'statement.cancel'.

schema.label: statement
schema.description: SQL text for execute.sql (POST /api/v2/statements). Required. Do not log if it embeds secrets. Example: select current_version();

schema.label: timeout
schema.description: Statement timeout seconds for execute.sql body. Official timeout. Example: 60.

schema.label: bindings
schema.description: Typed bind map for execute.sql, official bindings object {"1":{"type":"FIXED","value":"1"}}.

schema.label: statementHandle
schema.description: Path id for statement.get and statement.cancel.

schema.label: partition
schema.description: Optional GET query param partition (result partition number).

schema.label: requestId
schema.description: Optional UUID. GET: query param. cancel: JSON body if set.

ports.name: output
ports.description: Success: status=ok, http_status, data (result set or handle). Errors raise a BPMN error for the error boundary event (INVALID_INPUT, AUTH_FAILED, RATE_LIMITED, HTTP_<status>, REQUEST_FAILED); secrets are redacted.

configurationParameters.label: Operation
configurationParameters.description: Default operation when input.operation is blank. EXACT: execute.sql | statement.get | statement.cancel.

configurationParameters.label: Access token
configurationParameters.description: Bearer PAT, OAuth access token, or key-pair JWT (StudioQuack secret). Never the account password. Never log or place on INPUT.

configurationParameters.label: Token type
configurationParameters.description: X-Snowflake-Authorization-Token-Type. EXACT: KEYPAIR_JWT | OAUTH | PROGRAMMATIC_ACCESS_TOKEN (https://docs.snowflake.com/en/developer-guide/sql-api/authenticating). Default KEYPAIR_JWT. Blank omits the header.

configurationParameters.label: Timeout (seconds)
configurationParameters.description: Per-request HTTP timeout. Positive number; <=0 → 45. Distinct from SQL API body timeout.

configurationParameters.label: Account URL host
configurationParameters.description: Account locator host without scheme, e.g. xy12345.us-east-1.snowflakecomputing.com. Substituted into https://{account_url}.
